newsitem.title: ITALY: Max rate 8.05 pct at Italy lira reverse repo.
newsitem.headline: Max rate 8.05 pct at Italy lira reverse repo.

text.p: The maximum rate at today's 5.0 trillion lire five-day Bank of Italy reverse repurchase tender was 8.05 percent, compared with 8.30 at the previous reverse repo tender, the Bank said.
The average rate was 8.02 percent against 8.10 percent at the last repurchase pact for 14.0 trillion lire and two days on November 4.
The pact takes effect today and the securities are for resale on November 11. The Bank said it received 38 bids of which two were met in full and three in part.
